phase_name: CHGR Verification Cross-Artifact Digest-Binding Root-Cause Resolution
summary: Phase 146J independently investigated the authoritative root cause of Phase 146I's two Blocking findings (Finding A: duplicate-record_id order-dependent verifier resolution; Finding C: unenforced cross-artifact record_digest binding) without assuming either was exclusively a verifier implementation bug. Independently reconstructed the CHGR-001 artifact-reference model from primary sources (contract Sec.3 invariant 12, Sec.18 Security Contract naming 'one record being substituted for another under the same identifier' as an explicitly frozen threat, CHGR-REQ-081/082/194-209, references.schema.json, digest.schema.json, human_governance_record.schema.json) and from direct reads of governance/publication/record.py and governance/verification.py end to end. Independently reproduced both findings against genuine, production-constructed bundles (via build_publication_record, not hand-authored fixtures) through both the internal verify_artifact_at_path API and the real `pcae governance-record verify` CLI: the forged cross-bundle sibling produced byte-identical CLI JSON output to the genuine sibling. Established a new fact Phase 146I did not fully resolve: human_governance_record.integrity_ref and governance_record_integrity.payload_digest form a genuine circular dependency (CHGR-REQ-197 requires the reference to cite the sibling's own already-computed digest; CHGR-REQ-203 requires payload_digest to equal the top-level record's own final digest, which is only known after integrity_ref is already embedded and hashed into that record). Construction resolves this with a disclosed provisional-digest workaround, meaning integrity_ref.record_digest never equals the persisted governance_record_integrity artifact's real record_digest for any bundle, genuine or forged -- confirmed live for every run. Verdict: ROOT CAUSE ESTABLISHED WITH OBSERVATIONS, Classification D (Combined defect): confirmation_evidence_ref/provenance_ref binding is a pure verification implementation defect (Classification A -- contract and schema already require and supply a sufficient record_id+record_digest+record_family tuple, construction already populates correct final digests, the verifier's _find_related simply never reads ref.get('record_digest') and never detects duplicate matches); integrity_ref requires a prior, narrowly-scoped contract/schema clarification (Classification C) before any verifier repair can safely enforce digest binding there, because a naive uniform fix would reject every genuine bundle's integrity sibling. No repair of any kind was performed or authorized this phase. Recommends 146K (CHGR-001 Sec.26 Integrity-Reference Binding Contract Clarification) followed by 146L (CHGR Cross-Artifact Digest-Binding and Duplicate-Match Verification Repair), not an authorization. Full detail in docs/PHASE_146J_CHGR_VERIFICATION_CROSS_ARTIFACT_DIGEST_BINDING_ROOT_CAUSE_RESOLUTION.md.
tests_added_or_updated: No test files added or modified by Phase 146J (investigation-only scope; no repair authorized). Live reproduction of both findings was performed via a disposable scratch script (outside the tracked repository tree, under this session's scratchpad directory) that calls the real, unmodified build_publication_record and verify_artifact_at_path production functions directly, plus direct real-CLI invocations (`pcae governance-record verify`) against files written to /tmp.

validation_results.name: phase_146j_finding_c_independent_reproduction
validation_results.result: Constructed two entirely independent genuine four-artifact bundles via build_publication_record (distinct subject/option/rationale/preview_digest, no shared input). Took bundle B's confirmation evidence, changed only its record_id to match bundle A's reference, recomputed its own record_digest for self-consistency (left mismatched against bundle A's confirmation_evidence_ref.record_digest). Verified via both the internal API and the real `pcae governance-record verify --json` CLI: outcome verified, confirmation_binding: passed, CLI JSON output byte-identical to the genuine-sibling control case. Minimum-mutation ladder confirmed: record_id-only change (digest untouched) correctly fails DIGEST_MISMATCH (self-consistency check); record_id + digest recompute is the only variant accepted

validation_results.name: phase_146j_code_path_confirmation
validation_results.result: Full read of governance/verification.py (509 lines) plus exhaustive grep confirmed ref.get('record_digest') is never read anywhere in the module's cross-artifact checks; _find_related (lines 349-355) is an unconditional first-match linear scan with no deduplication or ambiguity detection; the identical code path serves all three sibling types (confirmation_evidence_ref, provenance_ref, integrity_ref)

validation_results.name: phase_146j_root_cause_classification
validation_results.result: Classification D (Combined defect): confirmation_evidence_ref/provenance_ref = Classification A (pure verification implementation defect, contract/schema/construction already sufficient); integrity_ref = Classification C (contract/schema incompleteness, genuine circular dependency the contract does not acknowledge or resolve). Repair must be sequenced: contract/schema clarification for integrity_ref before or alongside verifier repair, so the repair does not implement a rule requiring later reversal
